name: claude-launcher-minimal
description: One status bar button per Claude profile opens `claude agents` for your project in a pinned tab. Mailboxes let your agents message and wake each other, even across profiles.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted folders, the folder's own settings can't change your profiles, skip permissions, or auto-open agents.

claudeLauncher.dangerouslySkipPermission.description: Launch with `claude agents --dangerously-skip-permissions`, bypassing Claude Code's permission prompts. Turn off to get prompted as usual.

claudeLauncher.profiles.markdownDescription:
One status bar button per profile. **[Manage profiles](command:claudeLauncher.manageProfiles)** to add, rename, recolor, or remove them without editing JSON.

`configDir` sets `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` for that profile (e.g. `~/.claude-work`); leave it out for the default `~/.claude`. Names must be unique.

name.description: Label shown on the status bar button, e.g. "Personal" or "Work".

configDir.description: Value for CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, e.g. ~/.claude-work. Leave empty for the default ~/.claude.

color.description: Tints this profile's status bar button and terminal tab, using your theme's terminal colors.

claudeLauncher.defaultProfile.markdownDescription: Name of the profile this workspace uses. When set, only that profile's button is shown, and the keyboard shortcut and commands use it without asking. **[Pick one for this project](command:claudeLauncher.setProjectProfile)**, or set it in **Workspace** settings, e.g. `Work` for work repos.

claudeLauncher.mailboxes.markdownDescription:
Let your Claude sessions message each other, across profiles. When on, each profile gets the `agent-mailbox` mod (one folder, `skills/agent-mailbox`): every session gets a name, mailbox tools and a `/mailbox` command, wakes up when a message arrives, and shows a band above the prompt with its mailbox, account, context use and plan limits. Your settings, hooks and status line are not touched. Turning it off removes the folder again. Mailboxes live in `~/.claude-mailboxes/`.

**[Set up](command:claudeLauncher.setUpMailboxes)** · **[Create a mailbox for this project](command:claudeLauncher.createMailbox)** · **[List mailboxes](command:claudeLauncher.listMailboxes)**

claudeLauncher.openOnStartup.markdownDescription: Open the agents tab automatically when a window opens. Needs a single-folder workspace and a profile it can pick without asking: `#claudeLauncher.defaultProfile#`, or your only profile.

claudeLauncher.claudeSwapUsage.markdownDescription: When [claude-swap](https://github.com/realiti4/claude-swap) is installed, show each account's 5-hour and 7-day plan usage in its profile's tooltip, and turn a button the warning color past 90%. Read-only: Claude Agents runs `cswap list --json` every few minutes and never switches accounts. **[Show account usage](command:claudeLauncher.showAccountUsage)**
